homepage.hero.heading.message: Choose what every network and device can reach.

homepage.hero.tagline.message: Apply saved DNS lists to the whole network, one VLAN, or one device, with intentional alerts and no second box.

homepage.stats.heading.message: One firewall, policy at every useful level

homepage.stats.description.message: Sinkhole keeps policy local and makes its operating boundaries explicit.

homepage.features.heading.message: Control that stays on the firewall

homepage.features.scopes.description.message: Apply lists and allowed domains globally, by interface or VLAN, and by device.

homepage.features.savedLists.description.message: Answer DNS from saved local lists through restarts, reloads, and failed downloads.

homepage.features.alerts.description.message: Notify only for the lists, networks, and devices selected in each rule.

homepage.features.redirect.description.message: Optionally send port 53 traffic on selected interfaces to pfSense with explicit exemptions.

homepage.features.catalogs.description.message: Search supported catalogs on demand without bundling or recommending a list.

homepage.features.ipCountry.description.message: Apply IP lists and GeoLite2 country policy through the isolated sinkhole/ip anchor.
